dara: Heads-up from staging: when private tenants fall back to hosted, x-infer-probe and x-serve-affinity are intermittently stripped. Hosted then picks public authz / cheaper variant. Repro steps attached.

liam: that's the sidecarless handoff path. quick brainstorm: we can (A) re-inject headers at proxy for opt-in tenants, (B) use signed lease assertions (JWS) exchanged at onboarding, (C) mTLS client cert with SAN->lease, or (D) opaque token sync via federation.

meera: security take: header re-injection is risky by default. prefer cryptographic provenance: signed assertions or mTLS. But signed assertions need key exchange for air-gapped customers.

paul: proposal: add tenant manifest field probe_provenance: enum[mtls,signed,opaque,header_optin]. Default = deny (secure).

liam: implementation notes: signed assertion = compact JWS {lease,affinity,iat,exp,kid}. Verify once per-lease and cache for TTL. mTLS = tenant-subordinate cert onboarding (hosted-issued or customer-provided CA). opaque = periodic token push to hosted verifier if egress allowed. header_optin = allowed only when tenant toggles and we emit audit events.

meera: failure semantics: default fail-closed. provide per-tenant policy to allow fail-open with strong auditing. emit metric fallback.reason=probe_unverified vs fallback.reason=capacity.

dara: action items:
- liam: manifest PR + validation (2d)
- meera: security review for key storage and onboarding flows (3d)
- paul: small proxy patch to preserve header only for header_optin tenants + integration test (1d)
- infra-bot: run handshake-provenance CI job and post results

infra-bot: job/handshake-provenance/v3 queued :white_check_mark:

liam: tiny nit: make manifest changes backward-compatible; absent field -> secure default.

dara: will file RFC follow-up and link tests. meeting tomorrow 10am to review.
